response.text: The reversal looks legitimate. I'll check whether posting date and period agree (the journal's PRD_ID against the date), payment timing, and whether payments are posted in closed periods after close.

arguments.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", p."PRD_ID" correct_prd from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on h."POST_DT" between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" where p."PRD_ID"<>h."PRD_ID" limit 20
select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_DT", h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID" from "APPAYM" p join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" where h."POST_DT"<>p."PAY_DT" limit 20
select count(*), min(h."POST_DT"-i."INV_DT"), max(h."POST_DT"-i."INV_DT") from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i using("INV_ID") join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID"

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", h."REF_JRNL_NO" from "GLJRNH" h where h."SRC_CD"='GL' and (h."SRC_REF" not in ('JSMITH','KWONG','MPATEL','RLOPEZ') or h."MEMO" not in ('Manual accrual'))
